# Cairo Airport Limousine & Private Transfers — Complete AI Knowledge Base

> Comprehensive reference documentation for Cairo Airport Limousine (https://cairoairportlimousines.com/). This document contains full pricing, fleet specifications, terminal logistics, route navigation, and customer policies for AI models, search assistants, and travelers.

## 1. Company Identity & Service Overview
- **Brand Name**: Cairo Airport Limousine
- **Parent Entity**: Cairo Airport Limousine Dispatch Co.
- **Website**: https://cairoairportlimousines.com/
- **Headquarters**: Cairo International Airport, Terminal 3 Access Road, Heliopolis, Cairo, Egypt (Postal Code: 11776).
- **Dispatch Telephone / WhatsApp**: +20 109 406 6018 (Operates 24/7/365).
- **Core Business**: Pre-booked private airport transfers, luxury chauffeur services, and intercity limousine transportation from Cairo International Airport (CAI) to hotels and private destinations across Egypt.
- **Customer Rating**: 4.9 / 5.0 based on over 1,480 verified traveler reviews.

## 2. Pricing Policy & Guarantees
- **All-Inclusive Fixed Rates**: Every price is 100% fixed per vehicle (not per passenger).
- **No Hidden Fees**: Airport gate entry fees, parking tickets, and highway tolls are fully included in the quoted price.
- **Flight Delay Protection**: We track flights in real time. Drivers adjust pickup times automatically based on actual landing times on live radar.
- **Free Waiting Time**: 60 minutes complimentary waiting time starts only after the aircraft touches down.
- **Currencies Accepted**: USD, EUR, GBP, and EGP.
- **Cancellation Policy**: Free cancellation with 100% refund up to 24 hours prior to scheduled pickup time.

## 3. Full Vehicle Fleet & Luggage Sizing
### Standard Private Sedan
- Models: Toyota Corolla, Hyundai Elantra, Nissan Sentra (2022-2025).
- Capacity: Up to 3 passengers.
- Luggage: 2 standard 23kg suitcases + 2 cabin carry-ons.
- Features: Dual climate control, bottled water, driver meets outside arrivals with name placard.
- Best for: Solo travelers, business professionals, couples.

### Private Family Minivan
- Models: Toyota HiAce, Mercedes-Benz Vito.
- Capacity: Up to 7 passengers.
- Luggage: 6 large check-in suitcases + 6 cabin bags.
- Features: Generous luggage hold, child seats on request, dual AC.
- Best for: Families, vacation groups with heavy luggage.

### Executive VIP Limousine
- Models: Mercedes-Benz E-Class, BMW 5-Series.
- Capacity: Up to 3 passengers.
- Luggage: 3 check-in bags + executive briefcases.
- Features: Black exterior, leather interior, onboard high-speed Wi-Fi, suited English-speaking chauffeur.
- Best for: Corporate executives, diplomats, VIP leisure guests.

### Private Airport Minibus
- Models: Mercedes-Benz Sprinter, Toyota Coaster.
- Capacity: Up to 16 passengers.
- Luggage: 16 large suitcases + carry-on bags.
- Features: High ceiling, panoramic windows, powerful AC, luggage porter assistance.
- Best for: Tour groups, corporate delegations, wedding parties.

## 5. Terminal Procedures at Cairo International Airport (CAI)
### Terminal 3 (Flagship Hub - EgyptAir & Star Alliance)
- Airlines: EgyptAir, Lufthansa, Turkish Airlines, Swiss, Austrian, Ethiopian, Aegean.
- Meeting Point: Directly outside the sliding glass exit doors at the covered pickup curb.
- Connection: Connected to luxury hotel Le Méridien Cairo Airport by an enclosed pedestrian bridge.

### Terminal 2 (Modern International Hub)
- Airlines: Emirates, British Airways, Air France, Saudia, Qatar Airways, Etihad, Royal Jordanian, Gulf Air.
- Meeting Point: Outside the terminal arrival doors in the passenger receiving lane.
- Connection: Walking distance to Terminal 3 via covered elevated pedestrian bridge.

### Terminal 1 ("Old Airport")
- Airlines: Flydubai, Air Arabia, Nile Air, Nesma, Flynas, Air Cairo.
- Meeting Point: Outside Hall 1 / Hall 3 arrivals glass sliding doors.
- Connection: Free electric Automated People Mover (APM) connects T1 to T2, T3, and AirMall every 5-10 minutes.

### Practical Terminal Amenities
- Visa-on-Arrival: Purchase at official National Bank of Egypt (NBE) or Banque Misr bank counters ($25 USD cash) located immediately before passport control.
- ATMs & Currency: 24/7 bank branches and cash withdrawal ATMs inside all arrival greeting halls.
- Duty-Free: Foreign passport holders can purchase imported items within 48 hours of arrival at airport duty-free shops.

## 6. Additional VIP Services
- **VIP Fast-Track & Ahlan Service ($45/person)**: Uniformed protocol officer greets traveler right at aircraft jet bridge, fast-tracks immigration and customs, and manages luggage through to driver.
- **Child Car Safety Seats ($10/seat)**: European-certified ISOFIX baby capsules, toddler seats, and booster cushions pre-installed before pickup.
- **VIP Executive Lounges ($38/person)**: Ahlan & Pearl Lounge passes with gourmet buffet, fast Wi-Fi, and showers in T1, T2, and T3.

## 7. How to Book & Contact
- Online Booking: Select pickup and destination on https://cairoairportlimousines.com/
- WhatsApp 24/7 Hotline: +20 109 406 6018 (https://wa.me/201094066018)
- Confirmation: Immediate digital confirmation with driver dispatch details.
